Marlowe Tide Foundation.fact: SAMPLE: The Marlowe Tide Foundation makes multi-year grants for school success and summer learning in South Florida.
SAMPLE: Its board reviews new grant requests each spring and renews current grantees in June.
SAMPLE: It also funds family coaching and parent education programs.
